caption:
A candle poking beyond a level does not prove a breakout will hold.

Price can move beyond a visible level and then return to the prior range. Traders often call this a false breakout, but the label is clearer after observing the reaction. Look at the close, follow-through, surrounding structure, and your invalidation criteria. No single candle can guarantee continuation.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
